name: Nanjou Ran
source: The head of the Nanjou house. Several years ago, there was a test to decide on the common head of the diviner houses, and she lost to Souun by a large margin. Despite stubbornly hating to lose, she fell in love with him. Their love is mutual, but it hasn't been going well because of personality conflicts.
